name: peblo-notes
description: Collaborative AI-powered Notes Workspace — PEBLO Full Stack Developer Challenge

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.db:push: cd server && npx prisma db push
scripts.build: cd client && npm run build && cd .. && rm -rf public && mv client/dist public
scripts.postinstall: cd server && npm install && npx prisma generate && npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss
